verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an HR/payroll SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented full-data export, no open export formats and no offboarding path. The developer APIs and CLI are building blocks for integrations, and the reporting and pay-stub viewing features are adjacent; none of these is a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
